items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: INTERVIEWER: What was his name? Paul. Paul Garland.

ctx.x: Yeah. Was there any special clarinet players that you used to hear and get ideas from? You know, things that you'd whistle and then play there? Well, I think I like a little bit from the Sender County guys. Yeah. On the records? Yeah.
I'm back to your brother. Did he play with bands ever? No. He had started out on drums. He just played a few jobs. He'd keep them all. What was his name? Paul. Paul Garland.
Your dad, did he play any music, your father? No.
